description: Cumulative publication ledger of the Floe Skill Hub signed channel feeds. Each row records one publication commit Y, one channel, the SHA-256 of the signed feed bytes at that pin, and every packaged offer (id, version, contentDigest) it published. Rows are verified at use time against the signed bytes at their pin, so the ledger is an index of published history and never a source of trust by itself. It is cumulative: rows are never rewritten or removed when a version leaves the latest feed, because released bytes stay immutable forever. Append a row per channel after each coordinator publication run; do not hand-edit existing rows.
